player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngi jigéen {player_id} ci Wild Tic Tac Toe.
Ci wàllug jigéen, ngi ko defee ay liggéy 'X' walla 'O' ci séllule bopp.
Ngi gën a féewu ci séllule yi ñu def ay liggéy yi (X walla O) ci diggante.
Ngi ko gën a féewu ci ay liggéy yi.
Sàkkal liggéy yi ci bu njaboot '[X 4]' def X ci diggante.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Liggéy bu njaboot. Sàkk '[X 4]' walla '[O 2]' bu njaboot.
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Nomboro cell bu amul solo: {cell}. War na nekk diggante 0 ak 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Jëf ju amul solo. Seli {cell} dafa am na ku ko yoree.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} placed their symbol ({mark}) in cell {cell}
